whoFor: Founders and investors, in Nigeria or abroad, registering a private company or a business name with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC), Nigeria's company registry.

benefits.title: The right structure
benefits.text: Help choosing between a business name and a limited company before you file.

benefits.title: Complete, consistent filings
benefits.text: Names, objects, directors and shareholders checked before submission.

benefits.title: One person to ask
benefits.text: A named coordinator follows the application until the CAC responds.

whatYouReceive: A structure recommendation for your plans
Preparation and submission of the registration on the CAC portal
Your certificate and registration documents, with a list of the filings that come next
whatYouProvide: Proposed names, in order of preference
Identification and addresses for directors, shareholders or proprietors
The business activities and share structure you intend
Your written authority for SCS to file on your behalf
doesNotInclude: A promise of when the CAC will process the application, or of its decision
Tax registration, which sits under Tax registration and compliance
Licences and permits for regulated activities
